target_customer: Independent medical practices in the US that outsource billing
problem: Independent practices lose revenue to claim errors, denials and delays from insurers, and cannot trust an AI agent alone with revenue.
business_model: Service fee for end to end medical billing, likely percent of collections (not stated in sources)
product_category: Healthcare revenue cycle management with AI agent and theorem prover checks

founders.name: Aouss Sbai
education: University College London, MEng Computer Science
founders.background_notes: YC page states 362% of quota and $2.5M ARR at Grafana.

founders.name: Jad Sbai
education: University of Cambridge, PhD Machine Learning
founders.background_notes: YC page says Helical AI raised a $10M seed round.

competitors.name: Thoughtful AI
competitors.what: AI billing and practice systems, better suited to larger organizations per a guide

technical_complexity.rationale: Formalizing insurer billing policies and gating agent actions with a theorem prover, plus EHR integrations and HIPAA compliance, is harder than typical workflow automation for a four person team.

defensibility.rationale: Claim outcomes per insurer could compound into data and billing is sticky once outsourced, but funded rivals and incumbents like Waystar also sell AI billing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Press in 2026 describes consolidation in AI revenue cycle management and large funding for Candid; no action targeting Altair found.

market_need_then: Medical billing was estimated at a $280B problem in a 2026 Fortune headline about Candid, and insurer denials are a long standing pain for small practices.

branding.domain_note: Uses altair-health.com with a hyphen; altairhealth.com belongs to a different brain and spine company.

identity.visual_style: healthcare trust style with Trust Center and HIPAA badge
identity.voice_and_tone: reassuring: 'You take care of your patients. We get you paid.'

branding.brand_signature: Predict, Prevent, Prevail (a reply to insurers' Delay, Deny, Defend)

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with other Altair Health entities and the Altair engineering software company; the Predict, Prevent, Prevail line is memorable but only in YC copy.

outcome_analysis: Altair Health is a Fall 2026 company with a sales leader from Grafana and an ML PhD from Cambridge. It has no outcome yet. Its distinct angle is formally checked agent actions, but AI billing is crowded and well funded, and the shared name with other Altair Health entities hurts discoverability.
notes: No funding found; two searches returned only a different Altair Health (a New Jersey brain and spine practice) that PitchBook lists as out of business. The website names S7 Lab, Inc. as copyright holder; nothing else found on it. Investor logos on the site are YC portfolio companies, not investors.
